observations.prediction: Selected it depends on the triangle and locked the shape made by assembling its three corners.
observations.exploration: Tore the tall triangle corners: 70 + 65 + 45 = 180 degrees. Switched to flat: 25 + 30 + 125 = 180. Switched to lopsided: 40 + 110 + 30 = 180. In each state the three sectors filled a straight line at the top.
observations.reveal: The reveal corrected the answer to a straight line and accurately counted tall, flat and lopsided as three tested shapes. It explained the dashed line is parallel to the base, so the moved base angles fit the gaps beside the top angle, and that growing one corner requires others to shrink.
observations.visual: Inspected the inline dark 1257 by 936 screenshot of the flat triangle with corners assembled. Three differently colored sectors filled a semicircle under a dashed horizontal line through the apex. The triangle and numeric 180 degree total remained visible.
